title: Accounts Receivable Rule: Share of the Electricity Estimate Billed on First and Repeated Estimates
content:
# Estimate Share — Utility Services Program Estimated Electricity Lines

**Rule.** The estimated kilowatt-hours billed on a Utility Services Program estimated electricity line are the seasonal estimate times an estimate share, rounded to 3 decimals:

- **0.90** when no estimated electricity read is dated fewer than two whole months before the billing date and the Apartment Home Lease is enrolled in rent autopay;
- **0.80** when at least one estimated electricity read is dated fewer than two whole months before the billing date;
- the **whole estimate** (1.0) in every other situation.

A first estimate is tempered for a household on rent autopay because its statements are settled without the resident reviewing them, and a repeated estimate is tempered further because the meter has then failed twice.

## Combinations

| Estimated electricity read in the last two months | Lease enrolled in rent autopay | Estimate share |
|---|---|---|
| none | yes | 0.90 |
| none | no | 1.0 |
| one or more | yes | 0.80 |
| one or more | no | 0.80 |

## Worked case (hypothetical)

A seasonal estimate of 660.000 kWh on an autopay lease with no recent estimated read is billed as 660.000 times 0.90, which is 594.000 kWh. The same account with an estimated read last month is billed 528.000 kWh.
